journey.name: Review And Subscribe
journey.description:
Payer side of create-and-propose.xml. The proposed subscription arrives, surfaces under PROPOSALS, and opens the Review and Subscribe sheet where the payer swipes to accept. Accepting does not return to the list on its own: when the first period is due on acceptance the first payment starts by itself, from Lightning, on-chain savings or an eligible USDT-only payment, with no second swipe; otherwise the Subscribed confirmation opens directly. Both paths end on Close. A hardware wallet still shows the send confirmation for the first payment. Run this on the payer instance immediately after the creator sends the proposal. For the USDT steps, configure both apps for the local USDT testing stack and use local test funds only.
The handoff's "Automatically pay this subscription" toggle is unbuilt on both platforms.
The swipe knob is USDT teal when USDT is the only accepted payment method, otherwise brand orange.

actions.action: Launch the E2E Bitkit app with Paykit UI enabled on the payer instance, with the creator saved as a linked contact, on-chain savings above 5,000 sats plus the network fee, and no usable Lightning balance, so a first payment is sent on-chain
Have the creator instance send the "Journey Sub" proposal as described in create-and-propose.xml
Open the drawer menu and tap Subscriptions
Verify a row for "Journey Sub" appears under the PROPOSALS section
Tap the "Journey Sub" row (id "SubscriptionRow-<paymentRequestId>")
Verify the Review and Subscribe sheet appears with 5,000 sats and the subscription card showing its name and cadence
Verify the swipe control reads "Swipe To Subscribe", whether or not the first period is due on acceptance
Verify the swipe knob is USDT teal when USDT is the only accepted payment method, otherwise brand orange
Swipe the confirm control to the end

If the first period was due on acceptance: verify the Review and Subscribe layout stays on screen with the swipe control in its loading state and no second swipe is asked for, wait for the payment to send, then verify the Subscribed confirmation appears
If no payment was due: verify the Subscribed confirmation appears directly, with no send flow
Tap Close on the Subscribed confirmation

If a payment was made: verify its billing period is no longer offered with Pay or Dismiss, no Payment Requests sheet opens for it, and the home payment-request bell is absent when no other requests are pending
Verify the sheet dismisses and "Journey Sub" moves from PROPOSALS into the ACTIVE section
Tap the "Journey Sub" row and verify the detail shows STATUS "Active" and a RENEWS date one month ahead, with no year
Only when a payment was made: verify the PAYMENTS section lists it titled "Journey Sub" with the payment date as its subtitle. With no payment yet, the section is absent.

Have the creator send a second proposal for 2 USD monthly, accepting only USDT, with its first period due on acceptance; open its Review and Subscribe sheet on the payer with USDT enabled and enough USDT for 2 USDT plus the payment fee
Verify the requested amount is $2, USDT is the only payment method and the swipe knob is USDT teal; swipe to subscribe

Verify the Review and Subscribe layout shows payment preparation without another amount-entry step or payment swipe. Complete any enabled PIN or biometric authentication and required safety warnings. Wait for Subscribed and verify no Back button or swipe-back returns to the paid period; then tap Close.
Verify the first period has only one payment in activity and is no longer offered for payment. Reopen the subscription and verify its next billing period remains scheduled.

Have the creator send another USDT-only proposal. Enable PIN for payments before accepting it. Swipe to subscribe, cancel authentication, and verify no payment was sent. Use Back to close the payment sheet. Reopen the unpaid period and verify it waits at payment review without a completed Subscribe swipe or automatic-payment progress. Explicitly authorize it and verify one payment, not two.

Repeat with a USDT-only proposal whose amount exceeds the payer's balance including fees. Swipe to subscribe and verify an insufficient-funds or fee-collection error prevents payment. Close and reopen the unpaid period; verify it remains payable and no payment was recorded.

Return to the Overview tab with both the Bitcoin and USD subscriptions active. Verify Monthly Cost shows one total in the selected display currency, using Bitkit's exchange rate, aligned with Active and Created rather than separate stacked amounts.
